Listing a plugin? Check each of these before you open the pull request.

* [ ] `listings/<name>.toml` has `name` and `repo`, and `name` matches the file name and the manifest
* [ ] the repository is public and has `gmx-plugin.toml` with a `description`
* [ ] the repository carries the `godwinmix-plugin` topic
* [ ] pictures, if any, are in `gallery/`: `icon.png`, `thumbnail.png`, `screenshot-*.png`
* [ ] there is a release with one asset per platform, or the manifest has a `[build]` section
